author: nickyeow

english.text: He took up his pen and began to write.

jyutping: keoi5 ling1 hei2 zi1 bat1，jin4 hau6 zau6 hoi1 ci2 se2。
text: 佢拎起支筆，然後就開始寫。

author: nickyeow

english.text: Please give me a sheet of paper.

jyutping: m4 goi1 bei2 zoeng1 zi2 ngo5 aa1。
text: 唔該俾張紙我吖。

author: nickyeow

english.text: She taught music for thirty years.

jyutping: keoi5 gaau3 zo2 saam1 sap6 nin4 jam1 ngok6。
text: 佢教咗三十年音樂。

author: nickyeow

english.text: Don't speak nonsense!

jyutping: m4 hou2 hai2 dou6 lyun2 ngap1 jaa6 sei3！
text: 唔好喺度亂噏廿四！

english.text: Don't cry. I love you.

jyutping: m4 hou2 haam3 laa1。ngo5 oi3 nei5 aa1。
text: 唔好喊啦。我愛你呀。

author: kaenif

english.text: This spoon is for tea.

jyutping: ni1 zi1 gang1 hai6 oi3 lai4 bei2 caa4 jung6 ge3。
text: 呢支羹係愛嚟俾茶用嘅。

author: nickyeow

english.text: You did a good job.

jyutping: nei5 zou6 dak1 hou2 hou2。
text: 你做得好好。

author: nickyeow

english.text: Can an omnipotent God create a stone so heavy that even He may not lift it?

jyutping: maan6 nang4 ge3 san4 cong3 m4 cong3 zou6 dou3 jat1 gau6 cung5 dou3 lin4 keoi5 zi6 gei2 dou1 ling1 m4 hei2 ge3 sek6 tau4 ne1？
text: 萬能嘅神創唔創造到一舊重到連佢自己都拎唔起嘅石頭呢？

author: nickyeow

english.text: I made Tom cry.

jyutping: ngo5 zing2 haam3 zo2 aa3 Tom。
text: 我整喊咗阿Tom。

author: nickyeow

english.text: Layla tried to commit suicide.

jyutping: leoi5 laai1 soeng4 si3 zi6 saat3。
text: 蕾拉嘗試自殺。

author: nickyeow

english.text: Maybe the world would have been better off if the car had never been invented.

jyutping: jyu4 gwo2 jan4 dong1 co1 mou5 faat3 ming4 dou3 ce1，ho2 nang4 ni1 go3 sai3 gaai3 wui5 gang3 mei5 hou2。
text: 如果人當初冇發明到車，可能呢個世界會更美好。

author: nickyeow

english.text: There are many loopholes in this system.

jyutping: ni1 go3 hai6 tung2 jau5 hou2 do1 lau6 dung6。
text: 呢個系統有好多漏洞。

author: nickyeow

english.text: It is folly to buy things you don't really feel the need for, since you'll end up neglecting them and eventually realise you wasted money.

jyutping: m4 hai6 zan1 hai6 gam3 seoi1 jiu3 jat1 joeng6 je5 daan6 hai6 jau6 zau2 heoi3 maai5 hai6 jat1 gin6 hou2 ceon2 ge3 si6，jan1 wai6 nei5 heoi3 dou3 zeoi3 mei5 dou1 hai6 wui5 zoeng1 keoi5 baai2 maai4 jat1 ji6 bin1，jin4 hau6 faat3 jin6 zi6 gei2 dou2 zo2 cin4 lok6 hoi2。
text: 唔係真係咁需要一樣嘢但係又走去買係一件好蠢嘅事，因為你去到最尾都係會將佢擺埋一二邊，然後發現自己倒咗錢落海。

author: nickyeow

english.text: It is crazy of you to put your life at risk.

jyutping: nei5 so4 zo2 me1？wan2 zi6 gei2 tiu4 ming6 lai4 gaau3 fei1。
text: 你傻咗咩？搵自己條命嚟較非。

author: nickyeow

english.text: Are you guys free this afternoon?

jyutping: nei5 dei6 gam1 jat6 aan3 zau3 dak1 m4 dak1 haan4 aa3？
text: 你哋今日晏晝得唔得閒呀？

author: nickyeow

english.text: There are a lot of kids on the playground.

jyutping: jau4 lok6 coeng4 jap6 min6 jau5 hou2 do1 siu2 pang4 jau5。
text: 遊樂場入面有好多小朋友。

author: thesilhouette

english.text: Medical data is highly sensitive.

jyutping: ji1 liu4 gei3 luk6，dou1 hai6 gan2 jiu3 ge3 zi1 liu2。
text: 醫療記錄，都係緊要嘅資料。

author: thesilhouette

english.text: Mary was taking a long time in the bathroom, so Tom went to the backyard to water the plants.

jyutping: maa5 lei6 cung1 loeng4 cung1 hou2 noi6，so2 ji5 aa3 tong1 heoi3 hau6 ting4 lam4 faa1。
text: 馬利沖涼沖好耐，所以阿湯去後庭淋花。

english.text: I saw a group of turkeys in Hawaii collecting macadamia nuts and placing them in the road and waiting for cars to drive by and crush open the nuts, then they'd all run out and eat the nuts and a few turkeys would stand guard and alert the ones eating when another car was coming up the hill and they'd all run back into the bushes. I was impressed.

jyutping: ngo5 hai2 haa6 wai1 ji4 gin3 dou2 jat1 baan1 fo2 gai1 sau1 zaap6 gan2 ou3 zau1 gin1 gwo2，jin4 hau6 zoeng1 keoi5 dei6 fong3 hai2 lou6 soeng6，dang2 gaa3 ce1 sai2 gwo3 lai4，jin4 hau6 zoeng1 di1 gin1 gwo2 seoi3 hoi1，jin4 hau6 keoi5 dei6 cyun4 bou6 dou1 wui5 paau2 ceot1 heoi3 sik6 di1 gin1 gwo2，ji4 gei2 zek3 fo2 gai1 zau6 wui5 kei5 hai2 dou6 sau2 wu6 tung4 ging2 tik1 dong1 ling6 jat1 gaa3 ce1 soeng5 saan1 go2 zan6 sik6 gan2 je5，keoi5 dei6 cyun4 bou6 dou1 wui5 paau2 faan1 heoi3 gun3 muk6 cung4 jap6 min6，ngo5 hou2 jan3 zoeng6 sam1 hak1。
text: 我喺夏威夷見到一班火雞收集緊澳洲堅果，然後將佢哋放喺路上，等架車駛過嚟，然後將啲堅果碎開，然後佢哋全部都會跑出去食啲堅果，而幾隻火雞就會企喺度守護同警惕 當另一架車上山嗰陣食緊嘢，佢哋全部都會跑返去灌木叢入面，我好印象深刻。

author: Davidgo5867

english.text: And in my own life, in this country, and as President, I have learned that our identities do not have to be defined by putting someone else down, but can be enhanced by lifting somebody else up. They don’t have to be defined in opposition to others, but rather by a belief in liberty and equality and justice and fairness.

jyutping: ji4 hai2 ngo5 zi6 gei2 ge3 saang1 wut6，hai2 ne1 go3 gwok3 gaa1，tung4 maai4 zok3 wai4 zung2 tung2，ngo5 hok6 dou3 ngo5 dei6 ge3 san1 fan2 m4 jat1 ding6 jiu3 tau3 gwo3 zoeng1 kei4 taa1 jan4 fong3 dai1 lai4 ding6 ji6，ji4 hai6 ho2 ji5 tau3 gwo3 zoeng1 kei4 taa1 jan4 toi4 hei2 lei4 heoi3 zang1 koeng4。keoi5 dei6 m4 jat1 ding6 jiu3 tung4 kei4 taa1 jan4 soeng1 faan2 heoi3 ding6 ji6，ji4 hai6 jiu3 gan1 geoi3 deoi3 zi6 jau4 tung4 ping4 dang2、zing3 ji6 tung4 gung1 ping4 ge3 seon3 nim6 heoi3 ding6 ji6。
text: 而喺我自己嘅生活，喺呢個國家，同埋作為總統，我學到我哋嘅身份唔一定要透過將其他人放低嚟定義，而係可以透過將其他人抬起嚟去增強。佢哋唔一定要同其他人相反去定義，而係要根據對自由同平等、正義同公平嘅信念去定義。

author: Davidgo5867

english.text: Through the clear wintry sunshine the bells this morning rang from the gray church tower amid the leafless elms, and up the walk the villagers trooped in their best dresses and their best faces — the latter a little reddened by the sharp wind: mere redness in the middle aged; in the maids, wonderful bloom to the eyes of their lovers — and took their places decently in the ancient pews.

jyutping: hai2 cing1 cit3 ge3 dung1 jat6 joeng4 gwong1 dai2 haa6，gam1 ziu1 gaau3 tong2 fui1 sik1 zung1 lau4 hoeng2 hei2 zung1 sing1，zung1 lau4 zau1 wai4 hai6 gwong1 tuk1 tuk1 ge3 jyu4 syu6。cyun1 man4 mun4 cyun1 zyu6 zeoi3 hou2 ge3 saam1，lou6 ceot1 zeoi3 hou2 ge3 siu3 jung4——zung1 nin4 jan4 lim5 soeng6 zi2 hai6 mei4 mei4 faan3 hung4；gam3 do1 wai6 siu3 neoi5 hai2 lyun2 jan4 ngaan5 jap6 min6，koek3 hai6 jat1 lim5 ling6 jan4 geng1 jim6 ge3 hung4 jeon6 gwong1 coi2——keoi5 dei6 seng4 kwan4 git3 deoi6 jyun4 zyu6 siu2 ging3 zau2 soeng5 lai4，jin4 hau6 zong1 zung6 gam3 zo6 lok6 hai2 gu2 lou5 ge3 coeng4 dang3 soeng6。
text: 喺清澈嘅冬日陽光底下，今朝教堂灰色鐘樓響起鐘聲，鐘樓周圍係光禿禿嘅榆樹。村民們穿住最好嘅衫，露出最好嘅笑容——中年人臉上只係微微泛紅；咁多位少女喺戀人眼入面，卻係一臉令人驚艷嘅紅潤光彩——佢哋成群結隊沿住小徑走上嚟，然後莊重咁坐落喺古老嘅長凳上。
